crossRefs.note: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged…
for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her…
But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be…
For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who…
For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body…
I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…
Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.

translations.web: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge.
translations.bsb: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
translations.kjv: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
translations.asv: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; For God is judge himself. Selah
